title: CELM: An Ensemble Deep Learning Model for Early Cardiomegaly Diagnosis in Chest Radiography.
summary: The CELM stacked CNN ensemble classified cardiomegaly in a curated, augmented four-dataset chest-X-ray benchmark, reporting 0.92 accuracy and 0.90 AUC; this is a dataset-level model result, not evidence of clinical deployment or prospective benefit.
ai_technology: Three CNN image classifiers feed learned probability scores to a neural stacking meta-classifier for cardiomegaly.
